name: VA-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Longtime incumbent Bobby Scott running for re-election
Republican challenger Edwin Rivera raised only about $6,600
Prediction markets price Democratic win at roughly 95%
model.rationale: Bobby Scott holds a heavily Democratic seat with a large partisan lean and incumbency advantage, while his Republican opponent has raised almost nothing. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy Democratic win, so the forecast stays at Safe D.
model.watch: A surprise outside-spending surge for the challenger or an unexpected Scott scandal would be the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Bobby Scott, a longtime Democratic incumbent, is seeking re-election in a southeastern Virginia district that leans about 18 points Democratic. He has renominated without difficulty and holds a large financial edge, having raised roughly $688,000 to challenger Edwin Rivera's $6,600. Two independent candidates are on the ballot but show little fundraising or visibility.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets price a Democratic win at about 95%, consistent with the district's fundamentals. With the incumbent's advantage, the funding gap, and the partisan lean all aligned, this is a Safe Democratic seat with little realistic chance of an upset.
